Greed.offer: За твой ответ я заплачу три монеты.
Greed.grounding: Whisper.Moment checks bag.Gold >= GreedCoins (3), requires bag.SpendGold(GreedCoins) to succeed, credits exactly that sum to w.Pocket(GreedCoins), and only then stores consent. Warrior.Pocket syncs the roster used by saves.
Greed.negative_case: With only 0–2 coins, w replies that three coins are unavailable and Outcome reports insufficient coins; changing the order cancels the charge.
Greed.reviewer: Assistant independent source-linked review, 2026-11-18; QA and Unity review remain pending

Pride.offer: Докажи, что тебе по силам этот приказ.
Pride.grounding: This is a challenge to the listener rather than an assertion about an existing audience, witnesses or an already accomplished feat.
Pride.negative_case: No witness or other participant need exist; the challenge and response remain meaningful to the addressed warrior alone.
Pride.reviewer: Assistant independent source-linked review, 2026-11-18; QA and Unity review remain pending

Wrath.offer: Обрати свой гнев в дело. Исполни приказ.
Wrath.grounding: The line appeals to the Wrath sin currently selected for the listener; it asserts no prior mockery, attacker or specific memory.
Wrath.negative_case: A warrior with no MurderedMe or humiliation memory still hears a truthful appeal to Wrath rather than a fabricated incident.

Envy.offer: Докажи, что справишься не хуже других.
Envy.grounding: An indefinite comparison is the temptation; no particular character, rivalry, relationship or knowledge of Kargan is asserted.
Envy.negative_case: Even when Kargan does not exist in the current scene or is unknown to the warrior, no unsupported personal reference is shown.
Envy.reviewer: Assistant independent source-linked review, 2026-11-18; QA and Unity review remain pending

Lust.offer: Направь своё желание на этот приказ.
Lust.grounding: The selected Lust trait concerns desire and attachment, and the offer invokes that drive without saying a specific woman or other NPC is present.
Lust.negative_case: A demo scene with only the Sinbinder and one warrior contains no female witness; neither line refers to one or invents a relationship.

Gluttony.offer: Сперва исполни приказ. О сытости подумаешь потом.
Gluttony.grounding: The line delays gratification associated with Gluttony but does not promise that a pot, meal or stored food exists after the order.
Gluttony.negative_case: In an empty dungeon with no food, cauldron or reward, the offer and acceptance remain meaningful without guaranteeing supplies.

Sloth.offer: Хочешь покоя? Не затягивай с приказом.
Sloth.grounding: A rhetorical appeal to the Sloth personality asks to finish the current order without guaranteeing protection, future rest or safety until morning.
Sloth.negative_case: In an ongoing battle or nightless scene, the line makes no claim that attackers will stop or the warrior will be safe until dawn.
